  • Enum Constant Summary

    Enum Constants
    Enum Constant
    Description
    EACCES
    Permission denied: AccessDeniedException on a java.nio open, delete or move (FileNotFoundException on a java.io open); IOException on a map wider than the file's open mode; BindException on OperationType.SOCKET_BIND (a privileged port); on OperationType.PROCESS_START, IOException: Cannot run program.
    EADDRINUSE
    Address already in use: BindException.
    EADDRNOTAVAIL
    Cannot assign the requested (local) address: BindException.
    EAFNOSUPPORT
    Address family not supported: SocketException.
    EAGAIN
    Resource temporarily unavailable (the process or thread limit): on OperationType.PROCESS_START, IOException: Cannot run program; on OperationType.THREAD_START, the JDK's OutOfMemoryError: unable to create native thread.
    ECONNREFUSED
    Connection refused: ConnectException; PortUnreachableException on a datagram, SocketException on a read or write.
    ECONNRESET
    Connection reset by peer: SocketException.
    EDQUOT
    Disk quota exceeded: as ENOSPC.
    EHOSTUNREACH
    No route to host: NoRouteToHostException; SocketException on a read or write.
    EINVAL
    Invalid argument: SocketException.
    EIO
    Input/output error (a failing disk): IOException on a call on an open file, FileSystemException on a delete or move.
    EMFILE
    Too many open files (the process limit): FileSystemException on an open; also on socket connects and accepts, which open a descriptor.
    ENETUNREACH
    Network is unreachable: SocketException.
    ENFILE
    Too many open files in the system (the system limit): as EMFILE.
    ENOBUFS
    No buffer space available (kernel socket buffers): SocketException.
    ENOENT
    No such file or directory: NoSuchFileException on an open, delete or move.
    ENOMEM
    Cannot allocate memory: on OperationType.PROCESS_START and OperationType.THREAD_START, as EAGAIN; on OperationType.FILE_IO_MAP, the JDK's IOException: Map failed with an OutOfMemoryError cause.
    ENOSPC
    No space left on device: IOException on a write, sync or close, FileSystemException on an open.
    ENOTCONN
    The socket is not connected: SocketException.
    EOPNOTSUPP
    Operation not supported on the socket: SocketException.
    EPIPE
    Broken pipe (write to a closed connection): SocketException.
    EPROTONOSUPPORT
    Protocol not supported: SocketException.
    EROFS
    Read-only file system: FileSystemException on an open, delete or move.
    ETIMEDOUT
    Timed out: ConnectException on a connect, else SocketException: the kernel gave up on the connection.
